description: The Visual Dashboard (accessible via the 'active' tab in runner navigation) is the real-time monitoring hub for workflow execution in qontinui-runner. It provides: a top ControlBar (h-14) showing the running task name, workflow stage indicator pills, and playback controls (pause/resume/stop/auto-continue); a dynamic widget content area with a 65% active / 35% summary-stack split that supports 14 activity types (gui_automation, ai_conversation, verification, findings, shell_command, api_request, script, workflow_ref, mcp_call, execution_timeline, flow_execution, canvas, trace_viewer, playwright); a bottom status bar (h-10) with elapsed-time metric, current-activity label, orchestrator-agent badge, and connection-health indicator. Overlays include: a completion summary auto-dismissing after 15 s, a breakpoint inspector panel for paused executions, a human approval dialog, and an ActiveRunsBar multi-run switcher that appears when two or more concurrent runs are active. Keyboard shortcuts (?, Ctrl+1-8, Ctrl+R, Escape) are available throughout.

groups.description: The DashboardLayout content area assigns detected activities to widgets. The primary (active) widget occupies ~65% width on the left with a 2px accent border matching the activity type's color; secondary widgets stack compactly in ~35% on the right. Clicking a compact widget promotes it to the primary position. Each activity type has a distinct accent color: gui_automation=blue, ai_conversation=green, verification=teal, findings=amber, shell_command=slate, api_request=orange, script=indigo, workflow_ref=pink, mcp_call=violet, execution_timeline=cyan, flow_execution=emerald, canvas=rose, trace_viewer=sky.

The overlay shows: a header with success (green, checkmark, 'Workflow Completed') or failure (red, X, 'Workflow Failed') theme; a stats grid with duration, step counts (total/passed/failed), and success-rate percentage; a progress bar; and a Dismiss button. Auto-dismisses after 15 s. Escape also dismisses.

groups.description: The BreakpointInspector is a 384px-wide overlay panel anchored to the right side of the screen (full height, z-40). It opens when the user clicks Inspect. Content: 'Breakpoint Inspector' heading + close button (aria-label='Close inspector'); an info bar with step index (amber badge 'Step N'), step name, phase badge, and optional iteration; a freshness indicator ('Ns ago', amber if 10-30 min, red if >30 min); a Variables collapsible tree; a Pending Steps list; and an optional Last Screenshot thumbnail.
groups.name: Breakpoint Inspector Panel

groups.description: When a workflow step requires human approval the ApprovalDialog overlay appears on top of the running dashboard. It shows 'Approval Required' header, context about the pending action (summary, modified files, optional diff), a comment textarea, and three action buttons: Approve (resumes workflow), Reject (continues to next iteration), Abort Workflow (terminates run). The dashboard remains visible behind the semi-transparent backdrop.
